g1.flow: Two back-to-back curses on the man who 'thought and deliberated' (74:18). The first opens with fa: fa-qutila kayfa qaddar, flowing straight from his deliberating. The second opens with thumma: thumma qutila kayfa qaddar. The ayah after keeps the thumma going: 'then he considered'. Hook: fa first, then thumma, and thumma carries on into the next ayah.

cues.74:19: First curse, fa-qutila: straight after 'he thought and deliberated'.
cues.74:20: Second curse, thumma qutila: right after the first; next, 'then he considered'.

g2.flow: Same words in both, each after 'No! Indeed, it is a reminder'. Tell them apart by what comes next. Al-Muddaththir (page 577): 'they will not remember except that Allāh wills'. ʿAbasa (page 585): 'in honored sheets'. Don't stretch it: here fa-man shāʾa ends with dhakarah, not the longer ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlā of Al-Muzzammil and Al-Insān.

cues.74:55: Al-Muddaththir: after 'it is a reminder'; next, 'they will not remember except that Allāh wills'.
cues.80:12: ʿAbasa: after 'they are a reminder'; next, 'in honored sheets'.
